connections.name: Claude / Anthropic
connections.description: Claude subscription limits through Hermes' read-only Claude Code sign-in. Anthropic API usage is a separate organization-level product.
connections.state_detail: No Claude / Anthropic credentials were found in this profile.

scopes.label: Claude subscription (Pro, Max, Ultra)
scopes.detail: Claude Code reports a 5-hour session limit and a weekly limit on Pro and Max; Ultra reports a weekly limit. Hermes core reads these windows from the existing Claude Code OAuth grant without refreshing it.

scopes.label: Anthropic API usage (Admin API)
scopes.detail: Organization usage and cost reports require an Admin API key (sk-ant-admin…) with the admin role; individual accounts cannot use the Admin API. This card does not read, meter, or estimate API usage.

setup.summary: Sign in with Claude Code in this profile to read subscription limits, or configure an Anthropic API key for inference. The API key alone does not unlock subscription usage.

connections.verification: No live account in this build. Subscription reads use the existing core adapter; card states and metadata are fixture-tested.

connections.name: Google Gemini API
connections.description: Gemini Developer API keys for inference. API usage, rate limits, and prepay credit are visible in Google AI Studio; no supported account-level balance endpoint is documented for API keys, so this card shows setup and capability limits only.
connections.state_detail: No Google Gemini API credentials were found in this profile.

scopes.label: Gemini API key (Google AI Studio)
scopes.detail: Every key belongs to a Google Cloud project. Rate limits are enforced per project (RPM, TPM, RPD), not per key. Google AI Pro/Ultra subscription benefits apply in the AI Studio web UI only; direct Gemini API use is billed separately through the linked Cloud Billing account.

scopes.label: Usage and prepay balance
scopes.detail: Google publishes usage in AI Studio (Dashboard → Usage) and prepay balance in Billing. This build has no supported read-only balance/quota endpoint for an API key; it never infers remaining quota from rate-limit caps or local token totals.

setup.summary: Create a Gemini API key in Google AI Studio, then set GEMINI_API_KEY or GOOGLE_API_KEY (or configure the Gemini provider in Hermes). Monitor usage and billing in AI Studio.

connections.verification: No live account and no network adapter. Limit and billing statements are from the linked official docs; rendering is fixture-tested.

connections.name: Z.ai / GLM
connections.description: GLM Coding Plan or standard pay-as-you-go API access. Hermes configures Z.AI for inference; this build has no supported read-only quota or balance snapshot for Z.AI.
connections.state_detail: No Z.ai / GLM credentials were found in this profile.

scopes.label: GLM Coding Plan (subscription)
scopes.detail: The plan applies a 5-hour limit and a weekly limit, shared across supported tools. Coding Plan keys use plan quota and do not consume standard API balance. Usage is shown in Z.ai's subscription and usage pages; this card does not invent a remaining percentage or credit count.

scopes.label: Standard API (pay-as-you-go)
scopes.detail: Standard API keys bill per token from account balance or applicable usage bundles. Standard keys do not consume Coding Plan quota, even inside a coding tool. Plan and API credentials are managed separately and are not interchangeable.

scopes.label: Regional endpoints
scopes.detail: Global host: api.z.ai. China host: open.bigmodel.cn. Coding Plan uses /api/coding/paas/v4 (OpenAI) or /api/anthropic; the standard API uses /api/paas/v4. The key type, not the endpoint, determines billing.

setup.summary: Create a Coding Plan or Standard API key in Z.ai, then set GLM_API_KEY, ZAI_API_KEY, or Z_AI_API_KEY and the matching base URL. Hermes can auto-detect the global, China, and coding endpoints, or GLM_BASE_URL can pin one.

connections.verification: No live account and no core account-usage hook. Product separation and endpoints are from official docs and Hermes' provider routing; rendering is fixture-tested.
